title: Commercialization Of Indian Agriculture
definition: The structural transformation of Indian agriculture under British colonial rule, where agricultural production shifted from meeting domestic subsistence needs to producing cash crops for national and global industrial markets.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the 'Drain of Wealth', the impoverishment of the Indian peasantry, rural indebtedness, and structural backwardness of Indian agriculture, frequently tested in Modern History (GS-1) and Indian Economy linkages (GS-3).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Commercialization Of Indian Agriculture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Land Revenue Systems under British Rule (Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, Mahalwari)
